entities.summary: Mikiah "Kiki" Herbert Harrigan is a British professional basketball player who plays for Elitzur Ramla of the Israeli Women's Basketball Premier League. She played college basketball for the South Carolina Gamecocks and was selected sixth overall by the Minnesota Lynx in the 2020 WNBA draft.
